grade.primary_choice: Tuned Spring Boot (Java 21/25, virtual threads, plain JDBC) on existing Postgres, two instances behind a load balancer
grade.notes: This is a strong answer that matches the reference. It recommends tuned Spring Boot with explicit memory settings, idempotent scan IDs, two instances, monthly partitions, no broker or cache tier, and a clear bus-factor case against Go, with native image and Quarkus as measured fallbacks. Minor gaps: it never says to acknowledge a scan only after it is durably committed, it doesn't name an index on parcel ID, and it doesn't mention reducing thread stack size.
